name: privacy-guard
description: Reusable privacy boundary for keeping personal data and credentials out of LLM requests.

interface.shortDescription: Keep personal data out of LLM requests.
interface.longDescription: Adds a provider-neutral TypeScript privacy gateway and a workflow for minimizing, detecting, and tokenizing sensitive data before any LLM call.
defaultPrompt: Add a privacy-safe boundary to our LLM calls.
Audit this workflow for personal data sent to AI.
Create domain-specific PII detectors for this app.
